title: fix(plugin-auth): a user import reports an invitation the email transport did not deliver
body:
Fixes #23598
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

Setup › Users › Import (`POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-users`) invites an email row by asking better-auth for a password reset. With a failing email transport the import answered `200`, the row read `delivery: 'email'` with no code, and `summary.errors` was `0`. The administrator was told the invitation went out.

Measured on the unmodified tree (`8d05456cbe`), through the plugin's real mount, with the new door pins below: a transport that answers `failed` and one that throws both gave `nothing was delivered: expected 'email' to be undefined` (pins ①②④⑤ red, controls ③⑥ green).

## The mechanism, measured on the installed better-auth 1.7.3

- `dist/api/routes/password.mjs:82-90`: `requestPasswordReset` runs `sendResetPassword` through `ctx.context.runInBackgroundOrAwait(...)` and then answers `{ status: true, message }` unconditionally.
- `dist/context/create-context.mjs:215-224`: with no `advanced.backgroundTasks.handler`, `runInBackgroundOrAwait` AWAITS the send and CATCHES what it throws (`logger.error("Failed to run background task:", e)`). With a handler it does not await at all.
- So a throw from `sendResetPassword` can never reach the import, and the import's `INVITE_EMAIL_FAILED` catch was dead code for a delivery failure. No better-auth option makes the call rethrow (the only knob makes it stop awaiting), and `git grep backgroundTasks -- 'packages/**/*.ts'` has zero hits: this platform never sets the handler, so the send is always awaited here.

## The fix

The outcome travels on the same server-only scope #23343 added for the invitation copy, so it does not need better-auth to rethrow.

- **`account-invitation-marker.ts`**: a second better-auth request-state slot beside the invitation marker: a **delivery receipt**. The import's opener `runImportPasswordReset({ email, inviter? }, fn)` opens one fresh store per row that carries the receipt always, and the marker only when an inviter is known. It answers `accepted` / `failed` (with the reason) / `unconfirmed`. `settleImportResetDelivery(recipient, request, send)` settles the receipt and re-raises the outcome unchanged, so better-auth still logs it.
- **`auth-manager.ts`**: `sendResetPassword`'s body is wrapped in `settleImportResetDelivery`. The body is unchanged: two lines plus a comment.
- **`admin-import-users.ts`**: the import reads the receipt after `requestPasswordReset` returns. A row is reported delivered only on `accepted`. `failed` and `unconfirmed`, and a reset request that itself throws before any send (refused `redirectTo`, reset disabled, token write failed), all go through one stamp, `noteInvitationFailure`. The stamp is counted in `summary.errors`.

The marker's semantics are unchanged: its four legs, absence means the reset copy, and `readAccountInvitation` is byte-identical. The old opener `runAsAccountInvitation` had one caller, the import. It is replaced by `runImportPasswordReset`, which sets the marker exactly as before when an inviter is given. The module is internal and not exported from the package.

### The row of a failed invitation, before and after

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `ok` | `true` | `false` |
| `action` / `id` | `created` / set | `created` / set (the account exists; a re-import would collide) |
| `delivery` | `'email'` | absent (nothing was delivered) |
| `code` | absent (never reached) | `INVITE_EMAIL_FAILED`, already in the error-code ledger |
| `error` | absent | `User created, but the invitation email failed:` plus the transport's reason |
| `summary.errors` | `0` | counts the row |
| `summary.delivery.emailInvite` | counted | not counted (successes only) |

`ok: false` is what makes the failure visible. The Console's ImportWizard lists result rows by `!r.ok` (objectui `packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx`), and it computes `ok = total - errors` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/identityImport.ts`). It also keeps `rows[].ok` and `summary.errors` in agreement. A failed row is in both `created` and `errors`, so `created + updated + skipped + errors` exceeds `total` by exactly those rows. This is documented at the `errors` computation and in the changeset.

### Why this shape (four axes)

Three options were measured:

- **(a) A receipt in better-auth's request state. Picked.**
- **(b) A better-auth configuration that awaits and rethrows.** It does not exist. `advanced.backgroundTasks.handler` only stops the await, and setting it would also change every public send's timing.
- **(c) The import mints the reset token itself and sends the mail itself.** That copies better-auth's private reset mint: the `reset-password:TOKEN` verification identifier and the URL shape. That is two implementations of one route, and it breaks silently on an upgrade.

How (a) does on the four axes:

- **Business need, measured.** The import is the one in-repo server-side caller of `requestPasswordReset` (`git grep 'requestPasswordReset('` outside tests: one hit). The Console's wizard reads `ok` / `code` / `error` per row.
- **Long-term architecture.** No consumer-side tolerance. The producer of the outcome (`sendResetPassword`) reports it on a channel the requester owns.
- **Harder for AI to get wrong.** A receipt nobody settled reads `unconfirmed`, and the import reports that as a failure: absence is never upgraded into "delivered". The unit fakes that used to make `requestPasswordReset` THROW on a failed send were a shape the real API never produces, and that shape is what kept the dead catch green. They now emulate better-auth: they run the send, swallow its failure, and answer `{ status: true }`.
- **No scope spread.** No new error code, no new response key, no spec edit, and no new gate.

### The public door is unchanged

- `settleImportResetDelivery` hands a call that carries a `Request` (every HTTP request) straight to the send. It returns the same promise, without one extra tick (pinned: `handedBack` is the very promise).
- Each HTTP request runs in its own store (`handleRequest`), so on Node the import's receipt is unreachable from the public door at all. Only the address the import asked for can settle the receipt.
- Pin ⑥: a public `POST /request-password-reset` through a failing transport answers byte-for-byte what it answers through a succeeding one, and what it answers for an address with no account.

### WebContainer (`AsyncLocalStorage` across `await`)

The receipt rides the same better-auth request-state slot family as the marker, so on WebContainer it rides the synchronous polyfill `AuthManager` installs. It is read once at the start of the send, before any `await`. It is settled on the object the import itself holds, so nothing is looked up after an `await`. Pinned under the real polyfill in `account-invitation-marker.webcontainer.test.ts` ④.

## Bounded in-place fix: the SMS invitation

The SMS path's catch IS reached: `sendPhoneInviteSms` throws on a transport that answers `failed`. But its row kept `delivery: 'sms'`, stayed `ok: true`, and was not counted. That is the same row-outcome defect as the email half. It is fixed by the same `noteInvitationFailure` stamp, because all four conditions hold: the same defect class, a mechanical fix in the shape the email half pins, the same claimed file, and the same gate family. Evidence: `admin-import-users.test.ts`, the `INVITE_SMS_FAILED` pin (before: `ok: true`, `delivery: 'sms'`; after: `ok: false`, no `delivery`, `summary.errors: 1`). Ablation 4 below puts the old stamp back and turns that pin red.

## Tests

New: `admin-import-users-invite-delivery-failure.test.ts`. It uses a real `ObjectQL` over `driver-sql` + better-sqlite3, a real `AuthManager` with the origin check ON, the plugin's REAL `POST /admin/import-users` mount, and an email service whose answer is chosen per recipient.

- ① A transport that answers `failed`: the row fails, `summary.errors` is `1`, `summary.delivery.emailInvite` is `0`, and the account exists.
- ② A transport that throws (under `auto`): the same verdict, and no silent downgrade to a temporary password.
- ③ NEGATIVE CONTROL: `sent` and `queued` are reported as today (`delivery: 'email'`, no code, `errors: 0`).
- ④ One batch with a failing and a succeeding recipient: each row gets its own verdict.
- ⑤ A row whose inviter cannot be named (no marker, the reset copy): reported failed the same way.
- ⑥ A public reset is unchanged (above).

Extended:

- `account-invitation-marker.test.ts`: seven receipt cases, covering accepted, failed with the rethrow, no inviter, unconfirmed, a call carrying a `Request`, another recipient, and outside any store.
- `account-invitation-marker.webcontainer.test.ts`: ④.
- `admin-import-users.test.ts`: a refusal before any send, and a reset that answers without running the send.

Re-judged fixtures: the three failure pins in `admin-import-users.test.ts` and the harness fake in `admin-import-users-manager-pass.test.ts`. `durability-swallow-repair.test.ts`'s import fake answers without running the send. It asserts only the audit channel (status and warn counts), so it is unchanged and stays green.

Commands, results and commit:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3` on the final head `78aeb2c057`: **146 files passed, 2861 tests passed, 10 skipped**. The same result was measured pre-merge on `9c9a20348a`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` on `78aeb2c057`: exit 0, all three legs (`tsc` src, `tsc` examples, `check:test-typecheck` OK at 10 files / 88 errors / 23 signatures, after the shrink re-record).
- The targeted files (the 5 touched, plus the #23343 invitation, invite-link and durability-swallow files): 8 files, 114 tests passed.
- The new door file on the unmodified tree `8d05456cbe`: 4 failed, 2 passed (the controls). That is the red reading quoted above.
- Build state: after `git merge origin/main`, `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-auth...' build` exit 0.

### Ablations (one each, every leg through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`)

Each mutation was proven on disk: the anchor count fell by one and the blob changed. Each was restored with the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The subject is imported from `src/` by relative path, so no `dist/` leg applies.

1. **Put the swallow back:** the import believes the reset's answer (`delivery: { status: 'accepted' }` regardless). 8 red: door ①②④⑤, WebContainer ④, and three unit failure pins. Controls ③⑥ stayed green.
2. **Upgrade an unsettled receipt to `accepted`.** 4 red, exactly the unconfirmed-leg pins (one import unit pin and three receipt unit pins). The door pins stayed green, because real sends settle the receipt.
3. **Delete the leg-3 guard** (a call with a `Request` handed straight through). 1 red, the receipt unit pin. The door and #23343 files stayed green: on Node, the per-request store shields the public door on its own, so leg 3 is held at the unit layer. A first attempt at this ablation was refused by the tool (the replacement was a substring of the anchor, so no mutation landed and nothing ran). It was re-run in `--delete` mode.
4. **Put the old SMS stamp back.** 1 red, the `INVITE_SMS_FAILED` pin.

Pin ⑥ guards behaviour this diff does not change (the public answer), so it has no ablation of its own.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `78aeb2c057` derives 69 commands. Each was run verbatim with its exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: **69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. All 69 exit 0.**

- The first union, on `9c9a20348a`, recorded `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no `dist/` for 41 packages). On `78aeb2c057`, after the post-merge closure build, it measured green: 110 require entry points across 68 packages load, and the floors are met.
- The union on the final head stopped after 66 lines when the session was interrupted. Lines 67 to 69 (`check:type-check-debt`, `check:watch-hint-literal`, `check:where-matcher`) were re-run from scratch on the same head. The derivation is byte-identical and the tree is unchanged.
- Extra: `pnpm check:durability-log-level` exit 0 (46 durability-critical catch seams, all loud, rethrowing or propagating). A `dispatch-gates` change that landed on `main` after this branch's merge (`9a6f790a38`) now names it for a file with a catch around a durability-critical callee.
- The repo-wide farm (`pnpm lint` and every other `check:*`) is CI's. This PR's check-runs are the verdict for those.

## Acceptance notes

- The Console's wizard computes `skippedRows: skipped + errors`, so a created-but-not-invited row is counted there as "skipped", although its error line ("User created, but the invitation email failed: ...") says what happened. This is objectui's wording. It is noted, not filed: no carrier.
- `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` (Bulk Import Users) states the success shape only. Nothing in it became false, so it is untouched.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/test-typecheck-debt.json` was re-recorded because the debt SHRANK (`admin-import-users.test.ts`: TS2493 6 to 3, TS2532 4 to 1). The fakes now declare their parameter, so `mock.calls[0][0]` type-checks. This file is outside the claim's declared surface. The gate demanded the re-record.
